source: SPM 2026 Trial · Terengganu (MPP3) · English Paper 2 · Part 2 Q2 · Essay, 125–150 words
paragraphs: Time is a precious resource that, once lost, can never be regained. One thing that often distracts me from my studies is my smartphone. Whenever a notification pops up, I find myself mindlessly scrolling through social media for an hour.

I overcome this distraction by leaving my phone in another room while I study. Out of sight is truly out of mind, so I can concentrate fully on my revision. Furthermore, I use a timer to study in short, focused sessions. After 45 minutes of hard work, I reward myself with a ten-minute break.

In my opinion, students should do important tasks first because they can complete them with a fresh mind. Our energy is at its peak at the start of the day. Moreover, this habit reduces stress. Students no longer have to scramble to finish assignments at the eleventh hour.

words.example: Education is the key to success, but grades are not everything.
Many students bend over books under immense pressure to achieve excellent results.

words.word: a safe and supportive learning environment
words.zh: 安全且有支持的学习环境
words.example: Teachers must create a safe and supportive learning environment.
Schools should nurture well-rounded individuals, not exam machines.
Academic pressure is a heavy burden for many students.
As a result, they suffer from anxiety, lose motivation and even burn out.
As a result, I meet deadlines, avoid last-minute stress and make the most of my time.
I learn at my own pace without pressure.
Active participation made the event lively.
